value.hook: When a rollback follows a governance commit, check what the commit already landed
value.title: Rollback after a landed commit is a half-write

sections.name: body
sections.value: PR 345 review: assign_many commits to git FIRST and then indexes the store (flushed, record_assignment_committed). A store failure returns Err after the commit, so a caller that rolls back on any Err (spawn --as roll_back) kills the seat but leaves an open holding on the branch. In every review, sort each failure point by whether it comes before or after the commit. Also: when disk is under shared-build's 25 GiB floor, do mutation by inspection, map each mutant to the assertion that kills it, and say plainly which ones survive (e.g. a start-time guard with no test). FakeLiveness::with_recycled exists for recycled-pid tests.
